edits.text: PARTIES. This Share Purchase Agreement is between [Seller legal name and jurisdiction] (Seller) and Meridian Acquisitions LLC (Buyer). Seller and Buyer are each a Party.

1. SALE AND PURCHASE; PRICE. At Closing, Seller shall sell and transfer to Buyer, and Buyer shall purchase, [number, class and issuer of shares] (Shares), free of liens other than restrictions imposed by applicable securities law. The aggregate purchase price is [amount and currency to be agreed] (Purchase Price), payable by wire transfer at Closing to an account designated by Seller in writing at least three business days beforehand. Any adjustment to the Purchase Price requires the Parties’ written agreement.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur remotely by exchange of signed documents and funds on [date], or another date agreed in writing by the Parties, subject to receipt of required approvals and satisfaction or written waiver of the agreed closing conditions. At Closing, Seller shall deliver duly executed share transfer documents, evidence of authority to transfer the Shares and any agreed resignations or releases; Buyer shall deliver the Purchase Price and evidence of its authority to enter into this Agreement. Title and risk in the Shares pass upon completion of those deliveries and payment.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Each Party represents that it is duly organised, has authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, and that doing so does not violate any obligation binding on it. Seller further represents, as of signing and Closing, that it owns the Shares, has authority to transfer them, and will transfer them free of liens other than restrictions imposed by applicable securities law; that the financial statements identified in Schedule [●] have been prepared in accordance with [applicable accounting standards] and fairly present, in all material respects, the issuer’s financial position for the periods stated; and that, except as disclosed in Schedule [●], Seller has not received written notice of material litigation concerning the Shares. These representations are subject to disclosures expressly set out in the agreed disclosure schedules.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations to be agreed in this Section, Seller shall indemnify Buyer against direct losses arising from a breach of Seller’s representations or covenants, including liabilities required to be disclosed under an agreed representation but not disclosed. Buyer shall give Seller reasonably prompt written notice of a claim and reasonable supporting detail; Seller may assume the defence of a third-party claim with counsel reasonably acceptable to Buyer, but may not settle it in a manner imposing a non-monetary obligation on Buyer without Buyer’s consent. The Parties shall agree before signing the survival periods, claim thresholds, liability cap, exclusions and any fraud carve-out. No Party may recover the same loss twice.

delivered.body: Share Purchase Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between the Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price for the Shares. 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing. 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements are accurate. 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller indemnifies the Buyer against undisclosed liabilities.
